Market today: Tech saw an oversold bounce, but earnings this week are the real test. Your concentrated tech/chip book, especially on margin, means these moves hit hard.

Your holdings: CRWD (30.4%), QQQ (0.52%), SMCI (-26.85%), SNOW (-5.76%), MU (-30.63%), SOXL (-56.11%), SPAL (-35.9%), QQQI (-3.3%), SMH (-13.82%), SPY (4.37%), METU (6.39%), PLTU (3.36%), MSFU (0.67%). CRWD, QQQ, SMCI, SNOW, MU, SOXL, SPAL, QQQI, SMH are all marked SELL/TRIM and need attention. The leveraged ETFs (MU, SOXL, SPAL) are particularly concerning due to decay and large losses.

Watch: Earnings reports this week are the key catalyst.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your risk, especially with the leveraged positions and margin.
plays: Trim SOXL if it shows weakness; the -56.11% loss and decay are significant risks.
Consider trimming SMCI (-26.85%) and MU (-30.63%) given their current status and leveraged nature.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
